title: Surjectivity of the fibre product of modules over a fibre product of rings
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the fibre product construction on modules over a fibre product of rings preserves surjectivity, and the proof is an 11-line elementwise argument with two steps. It first lifts an arbitrary element of the target to an element of the source with the same first component, using the surjectivity of the two given maps, and thereby reduces to elements whose first component vanishes; for those it uses that the second component lies in the ideal times the module, writes it as a finite combination with coefficients in the ideal, lifts each coefficient to the source, and exhibits the preimage. Both the reduction and the explicit preimage are carried out in the source.
